strategic_assessment.headline: The org is paralyzed by manual approvals: 13 funnel fixes, the entire content engine, and Maya's beta sprint are waiting on Krish.
strategic_assessment.body: The automated pipeline is stalled at the human layer. Leo's 13 critical funnel fixes (including Stripe webhook and CTAs) are still waiting for approval, keeping MRR at $0. Cleo's 2-week content plan is fully drafted but blocked before the first LinkedIn post can go out. Maya's beta acquisition sprint to get 20 users per app is paused pending a $58 tooling approval. Meanwhile, external signals show enterprise buyers urgently need high-ROI strategy, and viral AI use cases show users crave brutal honesty over AI fluff. We have the solutions and the right tone, but we are completely silent.
strategic_assessment.recommended_focus: Approve Leo's top 3 funnel fixes to process conversions, green-light Cleo's content plan, and unblock Maya's beta tooling. Downstream outreach is wasted until the funnel works and the content flywheel provides air cover.

external_signals.recommended_action: Cleo to draft a LinkedIn post contrasting Mindmaker's brutal strategy sprints with generic AI consulting.
